payload.title: The mission scheduler's Thompson draw looks up draws by mission source_kind in a ledger keyed by plan-candidate source types, two vocabularies that share only github_issue, so outcome statistics never reorder missions and the test that proves the draw seeds a key no production writer emits
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/mission_scheduler.py:232-272 (draws are keyed by the ledger row's source_type)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/mission_scheduler.py:359-372 (each mission looks up source_draws by its source_kind and falls back to the static rank)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/mission_scheduler.py:60-79 (the mission vocabulary: capability_gap, finding, self_improvement, shadow_run_summary, pressure, service_hardening)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/autonomy_orchestrator.py:907-919 (the production writer records source_type from the plan pressure source, default git_diff)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/plan_candidate_source.py:45-83 (the writer vocabulary: operator_feedback, failing_ci, orphan_finding, f_finding, git_diff, github_issue)
aria-kernel/tests/test_mission_scheduler.py:303 (the test seeds source_type='finding', a key no production writer produces)
payload.rule_violated: One field name with two meanings (mission_scheduler.py:25-32 names the split) needs a closed mapping pinned by an invariant; the draw's docstring promises one draw per source_kind from a ledger of another kind.
payload.notes: Production writers put PlanCandidateSource values (or git_diff) into pressure-source-effectiveness.jsonl, while missions carry source_kind values from the mission vocabulary; only github_issue exists in both. For every other mission the draw lookup misses, so outcome counts (including cycles_rejected from change_outcome) never change a selection and the ORPHAN-HIGH-627 bandit is decoration. By reading, a kind that does draw (github_issue) sorts by -draw in [-1,0] while undrawn kinds sort by their static rank 0..5 (lines 362-371), so a drawn kind outranks every undrawn one whatever its draw. Close condition: mission_scheduler maps each PlanCandidateSource value to the mission source_kind that carries it in one closed table, with an invariant that fails when a source_type a production writer can emit has neither a mapping nor an explicit unranked entry; test_mission_scheduler seeds a real writer key and asserts that a failing_ci outcome history reorders two missions (red today). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
